Whipped Ricotta [BOOM 0103]

Prep: 10 minutes. Yield: 17 portions. Shelf life: 5 days. Allergen Call Out: Milk.

Ingredients

  • 3 lb Galbani Ricotta
  • 225 g Grated Romano
  • 175 g Water
  • 5 g Kosher Salt

Method

  1. Combine all ingredients. Whisk thoroughly until evenly combined and smooth.
  2. Use a tan #10 scoop. Portion into 17 eight-ounce deli containers.
  3. Lid all containers. Label, date and rotate.

LEAN Working

Stage mixing bowl, whisk, tan #10 scoop, and 17 eight-ounce deli containers with lids. Arrange containers before portioning.

Before You Start

Scale ingredients into the bowl in production order. Stage lids, stickers and PrepWizard labels.
